title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
summary: The complete Voice product is integrated at the root of agent-orc/voice-lint. Local merge 12e8bdb preserves the existing Voice Lint history and seven exported Devspace product commits through f19c7dc; future source commits belong to main and static website artifacts to deploy. Both managed local apps run from C:/Projects/voice-lint. Health, authenticated project access and the website preview passed; all six project IDs and browser enrollment were preserved, five internal roots were moved, and 55 session assertions passed. After relocation, 18 real Chrome session checks passed; local artifact validation accepted 99 files, 24 routes plus the redirect and 87 input hashes with --allow-dirty. Remote main publication and public website deployment are pending. Voice Studio remains a supervised local preview with original JSON/Markdown source mapping, guarded source edits, adjacent resizable review and sidebar panes, independently collapsible project/file sections and English/German Research. Earlier product verification passed 120 layout checks, 96 website views, 320 local targets and 106 backend assertions. The two libraries provide writing knowledge and host-driven tools separately from HTML visualization. Public pages expose no LLM capability. Reproducible offline quality evaluation is implemented; no model-quality run or measured winner exists. Historical audit references and evidence hashes are preserved.
